intent.oneSentence: A carried torch turns as short bright sparks detach from its authored flame.
intent.firstRead: Moving torch with independent brief sparks.
intent.mustNotReadAs: A phoenix, automatic anatomy tracking, or sparks dragged by the later pose.
intent.useContext: 96 by 64 native CPU preview against dark background.

readability.primaryShape: Narrow handle and changing warm flame tip.
readability.focalPoint: Flame edge at the chosen pose socket.
readability.depthAndOverlap: Small sparks detach in front of the moving torch.
readability.contrast: Warm body, small pale bright sparks.
readability.secondaryDetailBudget: 18 scheduled short sparks; no extra contact layer.

mechanics.source: Explicit per-pose torch tip, authored edge fallback when hidden.
mechanics.driver: Authored ejection velocity, captured once at each event.
mechanics.direction: Tip basis turns local ejection upward; fallback uses its own angle.
mechanics.weightAndMaterial: Tiny luminous cooling fragments with brief linear motion.
mechanics.causalChain: Moving pose and root sampled at birth, then fragments move independently.
mechanics.endingRule: Sparks extinguish by life; clip ends at 550 ms; blank at 800 ms.
mechanics.exaggerationAndLimits: Linear short-flight recipe, no fluid solver, anatomy inference, collision or artistic certification.

phases.name: action
phases.action: Carry torch across three authored poses and release sparks.
phases.cause: Explicit clip time and root path.
phases.visibleCue: Pose tips change while detached sparks retain independent motion.

phases.name: ending
phases.action: Last fragments cool and scene becomes empty.
phases.cause: Finite clip and finite spark lifetimes.
phases.visibleCue: No continuing trails or residual point.

omittedPhases.preparation: Already carrying a lit torch at scene start.
omittedPhases.response: No target contact is part of this example.
